items.headline: EU Leaders Fail to Reach Agreement on Long-Term Budget and Ukraine Aid
items.summary: European Union leaders ended an extraordinary summit in Brussels on November 27 without reaching a consensus on the bloc's long-term budget for 2028 to 2034. The deadlock leaves a proposed 45 billion euro financial loan for Ukraine in limbo as member states clash over spending cuts ahead of a year-end deadline.
items.question: How do you think European nations should balance supporting regional stability with managing their own domestic budget priorities?

items.headline: German Software Giant SAP Confirms Cyberattack Target Infiltrating Source Code
items.summary: Enterprise software vendor SAP confirmed it is responding to a major cybersecurity incident after intruders used stolen employee access tokens to enter its internal GitHub repositories. The company has restricted developer access and updated security credentials while reporting no indication that customer business data was compromised.

items.headline: MotoGP Legend Marc Márquez Announces Retirement at End of 2026 Season
items.summary: Eight-time MotoGP world champion Marc Márquez announced during practice at the Valencia Grand Prix on November 27, 2026, that he will retire at the conclusion of the season. The unexpected announcement is making international news as one of motorcycling's most decorated riders prepares to end his legendary career.

items.headline: Macy's 100th Thanksgiving Parade Takes Place on Saturday Following Historic Weather Delay
items.summary: For the first time in its 100-year history, severe weather forced organizers to postpone the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday, November 28, 2026. The iconic New York City procession is bringing its giant balloons, floats, and live star performances to audiences on its rescheduled date.
